senses.gloss: to hide one’s self; to be hidden, covered.
units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Lamentations 1:3">Targ. Lam. I, 3</cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Genesis 7:19">Targ. Y. Gen. VII, 19</cite>, sq. (ed. pr. = O. <he>אתחפ׳</he>).—
<cite ref="Bekhorot 43b:4">Bekh. 43ᵇ</cite> <he>דחַבְיָא מִיחְבֵּי</he> (Rashi, ed. <he>מִחְ׳</he>) when the head is hidden (between the shoulders).
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 60b:8">B. Kam. 60ᵇ</cite> <he>מִחְבֵּי חַבּוּיֵי וכ׳</he> he hides himself and walks (by the way-sides).
